versions.content: Allocation of safety measures to AUTOSAR elements The mapping of a safety measure to one (or more) AUTOSAR element(s) shall be ex- pressed in AdminData containing a Sdg named gid=ALLOCATION , containing sdx references to the AUTOSAR elements.
